title: dependency-model:service category
description: Out-of-project services the system needs: databases, caches, queues, object stores, search engines, and APIs. Records the thing depended on; the network category records the path used to reach it. The two link through related_ids.

status.description: discovered: the scan ran and this list is what it found, empty included. not-applicable: the category cannot apply to this project. failed: the scan could not complete, so an empty list proves nothing.

managed_by.description: How the service is normally brought up: compose, kubernetes, terraform, managed-cloud, external, unknown.

config_keys.description: Configuration key names (e.g. an env var name like DATABASE_URL) that point at this service. The matching config: id, if one exists, belongs in related_ids, not here.
